rationale.text: A chat script loaded from another site inserts a visible iframe without a title attribute. The test asks each frame of the page for a title attribute, whoever inserted it; the frame is not hidden with aria-hidden, so the technical-frame note cannot apply. The custom check examines the page as loaded and faults the frame (step 5), so the finding is failed at both levels.

citations.quote: Chaque cadre (balise `<iframe>` ou `<frame>`) a-t-il un attribut `title`
Pour chaque cadre, vérifier qu’il possède un attribut
